title: NetLink Broadband business broadband service agreement

sections.text: This business broadband service agreement is made between Acme Design Studio (the customer) and NetLink Broadband (the vendor).

sections.heading: Term
sections.text: The agreement runs from 01 November 2025 until 01 November 2027 and then renews for one year at a time unless either party ends it.

sections.text: The customer pays INR 999.00 per month, invoiced on the first day of each month.

sections.text: The vendor commits to 99.5% monthly uptime. Repeated misses entitle the customer to a service credit.

sections.text: Each party shall keep the other party's business information confidential and use it only to perform this agreement. This obligation survives termination.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.text: This agreement is governed by the laws of India. Courts in Bengaluru have exclusive jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.text: This policy sets out which business expenses Acme Design Studio reimburses and how to claim them.

sections.heading: Meals
sections.text: Meals during business travel are reimbursed up to INR 1,000.00 per person per day.

sections.heading: Local transport
sections.text: Taxi and ride-hailing fares are reimbursed up to INR 900.00 per trip.

sections.heading: Receipts
sections.text: An itemised receipt is required for any single expense above INR 500.00.

sections.heading: Approvals
sections.text: Any purchase above INR 25,000.00 needs written approval from the finance manager before it is made.

sections.heading: Reimbursement
sections.text: Approved claims are paid into the employee's salary account within 10 working days.
